# Engine settings

<!-- Generated by tools/knobs.py from core/knobs.def: do not edit (run tools/regen.sh). -->

Environment variables the engine reads, all from `core/knobs.def`. The app sets them from `ios/Solstice/EngineTuning.swift` and `Documents/solstice-env.txt`; the Mac tool and the tests take them from the environment. FLAG: on when set at all; BOOL: 0 off, other numbers or empty on; INT and DOUBLE outside their range fall back to the default.

## The translator and the dispatcher

| Name | Type | Default | Range | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HV_SUPERBLOCKS` | bool | 0 |  | Blocks continue past direct branches into one longer translation. |
| `HV_GROUPS` | bool | 0 |  | Neighbouring memory accesses checked as one group. |
| `HV_NO_RAS` | bool | 0 |  | Every return goes through the indirect-branch cache (no return prediction). |
| `HV_K2` | bool | 0 |  | Testing: each block in one part (hot and cold code together). |
| `HV_K3` | bool | 0 |  | Testing: every guest register spilled around helper calls. |
| `HV_TLBT` | bool | 1 |  | TLB laid out table-major (0: entry-major). |
| `HV_JIT_CAP` | int | 0 | 0..65536 | Testing: MB of the code region used from the start (0: all of it). |
| `HV_RECHECK` | bool | 1 |  | Exact check for accesses in a page's last 15 bytes in their out-of-line path. |
| `HV_SYNC_WAIT` | bool | 0 |  | A CPU waiting for TLB acknowledgements sleeps after 64 spins. |
| `HV_SWITCH_FLUSH` | int | 0 | 0..3 | Skip the local TLB flush xnu issues after a process switch (1-3: ways of checking it). |
| `HV_RANGE_DROP` | int | 0 | 0..1048576 | TLB range invalidations of up to this many pages in one pass (0: off). |
| `HV_MOVIMM` | bool | 0 |  | Constants built in registers instead of loaded from the literal pool. |
| `HV_PREDSTAT` | bool | 0 |  | Measuring: every access through the C helper, with prediction statistics. |
| `HV_WALK_LOG` | bool | 1 |  | Remote TLB drops skip CPUs whose page walks did not touch the page. |
| `HV_HOIST_CHECK` | bool | 0 |  | The exit check of backward branches hoisted out of loops. |
| `HV_IJC_PAGES` | bool | 1 |  | A code change drops only that page's branch-cache targets. |
| `HV_DNS_PROXY` | bool | 1 |  | The guest's DNS through the host's resolver. |
| `HV_WFI_SPIN` | int | 0 | 0..1000000 | Microseconds an idle CPU watches for work before sleeping. |
| `HV_FLUSH` | int | 0 | 0..2 | Disk flush: 0 fsync, 1 none, 2 F_BARRIERFSYNC. |
| `HV_NO_FAST_RESUME` | flag | 0 |  | Every exception entry and return through the dispatcher. |
| `HV_WFE_SPIN` | flag | 0 |  | A WFE always leaves for the dispatcher instead of waiting in place. |
| `HV_NO_STASH` | flag | 0 |  | A process switch drops the user TLB entries instead of stashing them. |
| `HV_IC_IVAU` | flag | 0 |  | IC IVAU drops the page's translations (as before they were kept). |
| `HV_IC_FLUSH` | flag | 0 |  | IC IALLU drops every translation (as before they were kept). |
| `HV_EXIT_CHECKS` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: every chained exit checks for an exit request. |
| `HV_NO_XCHAIN` | flag | 0 |  | Branches to another page never chain. |
| `HV_INLINE_XJUMP` | flag | 0 |  | Each branch to another page does its own cache lookup instead of the shared thunk. |
| `HV_C_EXCL` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: every exclusive access through the C helper. |
| `HV_TLBI_LEAVES` | flag | 0 |  | Every TLBI ends its block, as before. |
| `HV_SLOW_MEM` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: every load and store through the C helper. |
| `HV_BIG_LOCK` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: one CPU in guest code at a time. |
| `HV_JIT_POISON` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: freed code poisoned, and each block's flush generation checked as it runs. |
| `HV_CODE_CHECK` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: which code pages changed since they were translated. |
| `HV_IJC_DEBUG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: what came before branch-cache misses that were cached. |
| `HV_PSCI_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: every PSCI call. |
| `HV_BLOCK_DUMP` | str | unset |  | Measuring: a file for sampled translated blocks (guest and host words, for bench/hvdis.py). |
| `HV_BLOCK_DUMP_EVERY` | int | 64 | 0..max | Measuring: HV_BLOCK_DUMP keeps every Nth block. |
| `HV_PROF_FN` | str | run |  | Measuring: the function the profiler shows per offset. |
| `HV_KVA_HIST` | flag | 0 |  | Measuring: which kernel VAs get TLB fills, per bucket. |
| `HV_KVA_BASE` | hex | 0xfffffe0000000000 |  | Measuring: where HV_KVA_HIST's buckets start. |
| `HV_KVA_SHIFT` | int | 30 | 17..40 | Measuring: log2 of the bytes in each HV_KVA_HIST bucket. |
| `HV_STATS` | int | 0 | 0..86400 | Seconds between engine stats lines in the log (0: none). |
| `HV_STATS_DEEP` | bool | 0 |  | The stats lines with the costly diagnostics too. |

## The display

| Name | Type | Default | Range | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HV_HZ` | int | 60 | 30..120 | The refresh rate macOS is told its display has. |
| `HV_SAVING_HZ` | int | 0 | 0..120 | Frames a second shown while saving power (hot device); 0: every frame. |
| `HV_PVG_VBLANK` | bool | 1 |  | The display's refresh interrupts (0: none). |
| `HV_PVG_TRACE_FILE` | str | unset |  | GPU command trace while this file exists (checked as it runs). |
| `HV_PVG_TRACE` | int | 0 | 0..max | Mac tool: the graphics device's register accesses (level). |
| `HV_PVG_OPS` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the first of each channel command the guest sends. |
| `HV_PVG_NO_METAL` | flag | 0 |  | Testing: the graphics device without its Metal replay. |
| `HV_PVG_LITE_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the graphics device's own log. |
| `HV_PVG_TALLY` | flag | 0 |  | Measuring: counts of the guest's graphics commands. |
| `HV_PVG_HALF` | str | unset |  | "linear": half-float surfaces shown as linear at start. |
| `HV_PVG_FAIL_LIBS` | flag | 0 |  | Testing: every shader library refused, as an OS that cannot load them does. |
| `HV_PVG_NO_RELABEL` | flag | 0 |  | Shader libraries never relabelled for iOS. |
| `HV_PVG_RELABEL` | int | 0 | 0..3 | Testing: every shader library relabelled at this stage from the start (0: as needed). |
| `HV_PVG_RELABEL_QUIET` | flag | 0 |  | No log line for libraries loaded relabelled at the stage asked for. |
| `HV_SHADER_DUMP` | int | -1 | -1..max | Shader libraries kept while tracing: 0 none, other numbers all and blend states (-1: the first relabelled ones). |
| `HV_PVG_ARCHIVE` | str | unset |  | Saved pipelines: "0" none, "reset" start again. |
| `HV_PVG_ARCHIVE_MB` | int | 768 | 1..max | MB of saved pipelines at most. |
| `HV_PVG_HEAP_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: each GPU heap the guest makes. |
| `HV_PVG_HOST_DUMP` | str | unset |  | Debugging: file prefix for the first host surfaces before the guest's pixels. |
| `HV_PVG_SURFACE_DUMP` | str | unset |  | Debugging: file prefix for the first multi-plane surfaces. |
| `HV_PVG_DESC_DUMP` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: texture descriptors as read. |
| `HV_PVG_PLANAR_COPY` | flag | 0 |  | Every plane of multi-plane surfaces copied, not just the first. |
| `HV_PVG_PLANE0` | flag | 0 |  | Multi-plane surfaces read from plane 0 only. |
| `HV_PVG_PASSDUMP` | int | 0 | 0..max | Debugging: the first N render pass records, raw and as read. |
| `HV_PVG_SYNC` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: each GPU command buffer waited for. |
| `HV_PVG_CURSOR_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: pointer glyphs and visibility. |
| `HV_PVG_GPU_TEST` | flag | 0 |  | Mac tool: the phone's GPU path, drawn into a layer for screenshots. |
| `HV_PVG_SHOT` | str | unset |  | Mac tool: a file for screenshots of the drawable. |
| `HV_PVG_SHOT_SECS` | double | 5 | 0.01..86400 | Mac tool: seconds between HV_PVG_SHOT screenshots. |
| `HV_SHOT_SECS` | double | 5 | 0.01..86400 | Mac tool: seconds between named screenshots (for timing a boot). |

## Devices

| Name | Type | Default | Range | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HV_RAM_FILE` | str | unset |  | Guest RAM backed by this file (unlinked at once) when it cannot be kept out of the footprint. |
| `HV_RAM_NO_LEDGER` | flag | 0 |  | Guest RAM never kept out of the app's memory footprint. |
| `HV_RAM_NO_PREFAULT` | flag | 0 |  | File-backed guest RAM not touched ahead of the guest. |
| `HV_BALLOON` | int | -1 | -1..max | The memory balloon, asking for this many MB (-1: no balloon). |
| `HV_NO_SOUND` | flag | 0 |  | No sound device. |
| `HV_WRITE_CACHE` | bool | 1 |  | Disk writes through the host's cache (0: F_NOCACHE, for the restore). |
| `HV_BLK_STATS` | int | -1 | -1..max | Measuring: disk stats every N seconds (0: 10; -1: none). |
| `HV_BLK_SEG_MAX` | int | 8 | 1..max | Segments a disk request may have. |
| `HV_VIRTIO_CFG_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: virtio queue sizes and config reads. |
| `HV_PCI_LOG` | int | -1 | -1..max | Debugging: config reads of this PCI slot (-1: none). |
| `HV_INPUT_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: what the guest's input driver asks. |
| `HV_SND_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the sound device. |
| `HV_VUSB_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the USB device port. |
| `HV_XHCI_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the USB controller. |
| `HV_AVP_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the AVP devices. |

## Host: networking, sharing, installing, the clock

| Name | Type | Default | Range | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HV_NET_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: one line per network frame. |
| `HV_NET_FWD` | str | unset |  | Mac tool: "hostport:guestport" from loopback into the guest. |
| `HV_SHARE_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: every request to the shared-folder server. |
| `HV_INSTALL_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the restore's own logs. |
| `HV_LIBUSB_LOG` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the restore's USB traffic. |

| `HV_JIT_SPLIT` | flag | 0 |  | The code region as two mappings (writable and executable), as on iOS. |
| `HV_QOS` | str | unset |  | Testing: the guest CPUs' QoS class (ui, init or default). |
| `HV_RESUME_CLOCK` | str | unset |  | "continuous": no time passes for the guest while it is paused. |

| `HV_PROF_IOS_SECS` | int | 30 | 0..max | Measuring: seconds between iOS profiler reports. |

## The Mac tool (host/main.c)

| Name | Type | Default | Range | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HV_NO_NET` | flag | 0 |  | No network. |
| `HV_JIT_MB` | int | 0 | 0..65536 | Debugging: MB of code region (0: the default). |
| `HV_AGENT` | str | unset |  | The guest agent served to macOS. |
| `HV_INPUT_FILE` | str | unset |  | Commands (keys, clicks, knob NAME VALUE) read from this file. |
| `HV_CLICKS` | str | unset |  | Debugging: "seconds:x,y;..." clicks on a timetable. |
| `HV_WATCH` | int | -1 | -1..max | Debugging: what each CPU is at, every N seconds (-1: off). |
| `HV_TYPE_AT` | int | -1 | -1..max | Debugging: types "abc" after N seconds (-1: off). |
| `HV_TYPE_NO_KEYS` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: HV_TYPE_AT moves the pointer only. |
| `HV_PROF_ALL` | flag | 0 |  | Measuring: the profiler samples every thread. |
| `HV_PROF_PCS` | int | -1 | -1..max | Measuring: per-PC profile (2 or more: every PC; -1: off). |
| `HV_HOOK_SWITCH` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the hash hook moves to memcmp once a page is compared. |
| `HV_HOOK_OUT` | str | unset |  | Debugging: a file for what the hooks see. |
| `HV_HOOK_BOTH` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: both hooks at once. |
| `HV_HOOK_BCMP` | flag | 0 |  | Debugging: the memcmp hook instead of the hash one. |
| `HV_RAM_GREP` | str | unset |  | Debugging: guest RAM lines with any of these words (the kernel's log) at the end. |
| `HV_RAM_GREP_OUT` | str | /dev/stderr |  | Debugging: where HV_RAM_GREP writes. |
| `HV_BOOT_DISPLAY_DUMP` | str | unset |  | Debugging: a file for the boot framebuffer (raw BGRA). |
| `HV_INSTALL_STOP_AT_END` | flag | 0 |  | The Mac tool ends when an install ends. |

## Read by the app (Swift) or the tests only, listed so nothing unknown is set

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HV_SAFE` | str | unset |  | App: 1 or 0 decides safe mode (upstream's engine settings) by hand. |
| `HV_LOG_CONSOLE` | str | unset |  | App: a copy of the log on the original stderr (for devicectl --console). |
| `HV_TRACE` | flag | 0 |  | Tests: every block traced. |
| `HV_DUMP` | str | unset |  | Tests: a file for test_bench's translated code. |
| `HV_TEST_WORK` | str | unset |  | Tests: test_devices' work folder. |
